To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the amount of environmental disclosure in annual reports is positively related to external pressures, but not to actual environmental performance; and that environmental disclosure is associated with the use of other social disclosures.

the environmental disclosures in annual report are influenced by the level of external pressure, the type of industry, the size of the company, the level of pollution and the type of pollution, and that environmental disclosures are positively associated with the level of pollution.

the environmental disclosures in Canadian annual reports are influenced by the nature and strength of the environmental pressures on the firm and that these disclosures tend to be positive, highlighting positive environmental actions and/or obfuscating negative environmental effects.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the management of corporate image and the management of the environment.
the extent to which annual reports are used by firms to manage their public impressions.
how public corporations respond to environmental pressures, and the role and impact of environmental disclosures in annual report.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

environmental disclosures are a form of corporate social responsibility that can be viewed as both positive and negative, and that the nature of the disclosures are dependent on the industry and the firm's performance.
the environmental disclosure process is a complex and multifaceted phenomenon, and that it is not easily understood in the context of a single theoretical framework.
environmental disclosures are a form of corporate public relations, and that they are a means for corporations to manage their public image.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
environmental disclosures are not simply a function of the external pressures placed upon companies.
the environmental disclosures in the annual reports are not simply a response to external pressures, but rather are an integral part of the overall corporate communication strategy.
the disclosures in annual reports are a function of external pressures and that the nature of the disclosures are influenced by the nature of the industry and the nature of the environmental issues.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the environmental disclosures included within annual reports are a function of both external pressure and the characteristics of the company, and that the environmental disclosures in annual report are not a function of actual performance.
environmental disclosures are a function of both the characteristics of the industry and the company.
environmental disclosures are a form of strategic communication.
